observations: Photo 0 shows a black 3-seater couch with tufted/boxy cushions and gold-colored legs.
Photo 1 shows the same black couch from a different angle; gold legs visible.
Photo 2 shows a black 2-seater couch (smaller width than photo 0/1) with the same tufted style and gold-colored legs.
No visible stains/tears are clearly shown in the provided angles, but the photos do not show close-ups of fabric seams or underside.

claims.claim: Used 3 Seaters and 2 Seaters Couch going for giveaway price
claims.evidence: Photos show one 3-seater (photos 0/1) and one 2-seater (photo 2), but the 'giveaway price' is not verifiable from photos.
No receipt/date tag or proof of purchase shown in the photos.
Photos do not show clear stains/tears, but there are no close-up shots of seams, corners, or fabric texture.
No sit/press test or close-up of cushion recovery shown.
No odor test or cleaning/air quality proof shown.

risks.risk: Hidden fabric damage (tears, worn spots) at seams/corners not visible in these angles
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of: (1) all cushion seams, (2) both arm corners, (3) backrest edges, (4) underside/legs area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor wear (worst case: treat as not guaranteed stain/tear-free).

risks.risk: Foam sagging or poor cushion recovery (seller says firm, but photos can’t confirm)
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of someone pressing each seat cushion and releasing to show rebound, plus a quick sit test on both couches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed firm (worst case: cushions may be slightly sagging).

risks.risk: Odor/smoke retention not detectable from photos
risks.proof: Ask for a video where the seller opens the couch area/under-seat and shows it freshly aired; also request confirmation of no lingering smell during viewing (buyer sniff test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if odor risk exists (worst case: assume it may need deodorizing/cleaning).

risks.risk: Missing parts or structural issues (loose legs, frame wobble) not shown
risks.proof: Request a video showing the couch being gently rocked and legs checked for wobble, plus a photo of the underside/frame connection points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if structural condition is not guaranteed (worst case: may require tightening/repair).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of all seams, corners, and cushion edges for both the 3-seater and 2-seater.
Short video showing cushion press/rebound for each seat (firmness check).
Video check of leg stability (rock test) and underside/frame condition.
Any proof of purchase/date (receipt, order confirmation, or delivery note) to support 'bought new last year'.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a black tufted 3-seater and a black tufted 2-seater with gold legs, but key value drivers (foam firmness, hidden tears/stains, smoke/odor, and structural integrity) cannot be confirmed remotely from these angles. Request the specific close-ups and press/rock videos before pricing confidently.
